name: 44503 · Youngstown, OH
findings: ZIP 44503 (Youngstown) has 68 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Political organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44503 (Youngstown) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
69% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44503 (Youngstown) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 23.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 82% of all organizations here have no identified type.
